newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields edge down, crown weaker.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields edge down, crown weaker.

text.p: Swedish debt yields inched down slightly on Tuesday and the crown weakened.

"The spread against Germany increased a few basis points on Monday. Today's decrease is partly a small recoil from this," one analyst said. The spread between Swedish and German ten-year bond yields narrowed three basis points to 90.
Lower debt yields in Italy might also have lent support to the Swedish market, dealers said.
The levelling out of the Swedish yield curve continued today. The spread between the ten-year bond and the 18 month-bond decreased by 2 basis points to 183 basis points.
The crown was weaker against the dollar at 7.7654 from 7.6997 late Monday.
The crown was slightly weaker against the mark at 4.4270 from yesterday's 4.4170. Trading in the crown is very thin, with most market players soaking up the sun.
For the rest of the day the crown is expected to trade between 4.4150 and 4.4350.
The market is focusing on politics in Europe with possible statements about the EMU, one analyst said.
